# Otterleo — The Fun Way to Learn Drawing

> Otterleo is an interactive drawing and sketching learning platform where users can learn drawing and sketching in a fun way. Master sketching using an interactive canvas, complete daily challenges, compete on global leaderboards, gain XP, unlock cool avatars, and get instant feedback using our AI artwork scanner.

## Core Pages
- https://www.otterleo.in : Main fun drawing website homepage, interactive canvas, and live leaderboards.
- https://www.otterleo.in/about : What is Otterleo, Otto mascot guide, and FAQs.
- https://www.otterleo.in/login : User authentication and account login.
- https://www.otterleo.in/signup : Account creation page to start learning and gaining XP.

## Key Features
- AI Artwork Scan Feature: Scan physical paper artwork or digital sketches to get instant AI feedback, detailed tips, and a precision score based on drawing accuracy.
- Fun Drawing Challenges & XP: Complete step-by-step sketch challenges to gain XP, unlock custom avatars, build daily streaks, and level up art skills.
- Otterleo Canvas Practice: Practice directly on the built-in digital canvas or upload physical artwork to refine techniques anytime.
- Leaderboards & Community Competition: Compete with other artists worldwide on the global leaderboard, showcase scores, and track rank.
- Mascot Otto Guidance: Learn art fundamentals through bite-sized, gamified lessons guided by Otto the otter.
- Founder Story: Founded and built by 15-year-old tech founder Harjas Digga to make art education affordable and fun for everyone.
